So just to give you an overview of the program and for those who may not know what travel training is.
It's a comprehensive instruction designed to teach anyone of any age how to travel safely and independently on public transportation here in Saskatoon.
We have three versions of the program.
The first is experience transit, which is geared towards students, newcomers, older adults or simply anyone interested.
I provide a 30 minute presentation giving an overview of Saskatoon transit.
Some individuals feel ready and are able to use transit on their own after this presentation.
But if requested, they can also do a practice bus trip in the community to utilize the skills that they learned.

And then the last version of experience transit is experience transit plus and so this is for individuals who may not qualify for access transit.
And need multiple one on one training sessions to learn how to use fixed route transit independently.
Just before winter began, I was working with two university students who found using both access transit and fixed route to be beneficial for their lifestyle.
This was because before travel training, they were hesitant to use fixed route transit on their own.
But after a few sessions, it gave them a sense of confidence and a bit more freedom so that they are able to combine the services to meet their needs.
And I will be continuing some additional training with them as soon as it's not as I see out on the sidewalks here in Saskatoon.
So in 2022, we did train the trainer with 10 organizations.
I provided 36 community presentations and I also helped deliver 37 one-on-one training sessions.
And so in the picture you can see along with me to assist with the training.
